channel.title: Frantz Augustin
channel.description: Independent researcher and creative exploring meaning, perception, and how people interact with intelligent systems.

item.title: Move 37
item.description: I think thirty-seven is three sets of ten and one set of seven. Why is a number not a letter? Or are letters and numbers just strings in computer programs, symbols in the real world? An unusual thirty-seventh move played by Google's AI in the game of Go made me wonder about unity, perfection, and the hand of God in my life.
